name: template_packagings
note: ProductTemplate.uom_ids (addons/product/models/product_template.py:160): the additional packagings of each template as the many2many reads them
source_sql: SELECT product_template_id, uom_uom_id FROM product_template_uom_uom_rel ORDER BY product_template_id, uom_uom_id

name: packagings_per_template
note: ProductTemplate.uom_ids count per template (the packaging selector on the sale line)
source_sql: SELECT product_template_id, count(*) AS packagings FROM product_template_uom_uom_rel GROUP BY product_template_id ORDER BY product_template_id
